name: Fashion Editorial
summary: Swiss International Typographic Style meets avant-garde fashion editorial: black-and-white image states, semi-transparent cobalt interruptions, giant Didone and ultra-condensed type, and type-as-image, all held by a measured 12-column grid.
use_when: 时尚 / 文化 / 品牌画册
宣言式提案、强视觉叙事
瑞士国际主义网格 × 先锋编辑风的版面

stage2_seeds.mode_behavior: Showcase pacing for a read-close fashion document: image-led statements alternate with measured reading pages; each page carries one governing message; use the sequence that serves the argument unless source order is required.
stage2_seeds.visual_style_behavior: Black-and-white photography in four interchangeable states (full bleed, framed inset, colour-tinted, type-mask); cobalt appears as a partially transparent interruption rather than a flat background; oversized Didone words, ultra-condensed capitals and hairline rules sit on a strict 12-column Swiss grid. Let type, image and transparency overlap deliberately, but keep reading text on a calm field and fully legible.

typography.ladder_note: Calibrated for physical A4 print (210 x 297 mm = 595.28 x 841.89 pt on the 1240 x 1754 authoring canvas, where 1 SVG unit = 0.48 pt). At A4 print: annotation/microtext floor 14 = 6.7 pt (never drop below 14 on A4), caption/kicker 16 = 7.7 pt, body 23 = 11.0 pt, lead 28 = 13.4 pt, statement 58 = 27.8 pt, display 92 = 44.2 pt, hero 160 = 76.8 pt, oversized poster numerals 204-300 = 98-144 pt.

postexport.render_check: on request or when validating an optional font variant

mirror.html_css_overrides: @font-face{font-family:"Noto Sans CJK SC";src:local("PingFang SC");font-weight:400 900}@font-face{font-family:"Noto Serif CJK SC";src:local("Songti SC");font-weight:400 900}

design_defaults: 用“影像状态”而不是固定版式组织页面：全出血、内嵌画框、钴蓝染色、字即图四种状态循环出现；每种状态都必须服务当前页面的信息任务。
基于 A4 物理印刷换算（1240×1754 画布上 1 单位 ≈ 0.48 pt）与瑞士国际主义尺度极差规划：微字与图注不低于 14–16px（6.7–7.7 pt，绝不使用 8–11px 不可读微缩字），正文 22–24px Regular，导语 28px，宣言 54–64px，巨型陈列字 158–300px。
钴蓝是打断与节奏，不是底色。色块使用 0.14–0.92 的透明度阶梯，让照片和巨型字在叠透中仍然可见；纯色块只用于需要绝对重量的短句。
以十二栏瑞士网格、发丝线、页眉页码和严格基线建立秩序，再用不对称的大字、越界字和图像切口制造先锋感；秩序与破坏必须同时可读，阅读动线严格匹配信息重要顺序。
字体层级固定为：Bodoni Moda 巨型 Didone 标题与数字、Six Caps 超窄大写、Archivo 中性无衬线正文与微文字；不混入第四种展示字体。
字即图（type-as-image）：把真实人像裁进超窄字母内部，生成透明 PNG；所有需要阅读、编辑的文字仍保持原生文本。
黑白人像承担情绪，钴蓝承担结构，纸色承担呼吸；避免彩色照片、渐变彩虹和高光滤镜破坏编辑感。
所有图片使用可商用图库并记录来源；不使用时尚杂志扫描图、品牌广告图或可识别品牌标志，不把生成图说成实拍。
